title: Democratic Quality Scorecard: National Anti Counterfeiting Product Integrity and Quality Standards Bill

dimensions.evidence: Protects Article 21 health and consumer safety rights against hazardous/spurious goods.
Protects innocent small retailers under Clause 11 bona fide purchaser defense.
Life imprisonment for life-critical counterfeits; summary asset forfeiture of syndicates.
Independent National Anti-Counterfeiting Authority with judicial trial oversight by Special Courts.
Real-time open National Product Authenticity Information Portal for instant consumer scanning.
Asset forfeiture, e-commerce strict liability, 10x consumer compensation.
13 languages, instant mobile QR code scanning.
